title: Run the wrapper quality gate against a frozen candidate in a clean workspace
description:
Objective: verify the code that will actually be delivered. The wrapper's optional quality gate currently runs in the shared project directory before candidate attribution and staging, so it can pass using a dirty helper file that never reaches the final commit, and a CAS retry can rebuild the candidate against an advanced tip without repeating the gate.

Deliverable: in scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1, the landing path freezes the candidate tree first, records it with record_candidate, materializes that tree in a clean workspace, runs the configured gate there, reports the outcome with record_check_run, and calls finalize_attempt with the landing result. A CAS retry that rebuilds the candidate against a new tip produces a new candidate and reruns the gate rather than reusing the old result.

Not in scope: the receipt record and target-movement recheck, which is the sibling task. Keep every existing landing guarantee: pathspec-only attribution, the tier rules, rescue refs on any failure, and the refusal codes.

Both wrappers must stay in parity; scripts/tests/parity-check.sh enforces shared strings.

Verification: bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh, on a quiet box with MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=180.
definitionOfDone: Both wrappers freeze the candidate tree before running the gate and record it via record_candidate
The gate runs against the frozen tree materialized in a clean workspace, not the shared dirty project directory
The gate outcome is reported via record_check_run with the tree sha it ran against, and finalize_attempt is called with the landing result
A CAS retry against an advanced tip creates a new candidate and reruns the gate instead of reusing the previous result
Existing landing behaviour is preserved: pathspec-only attribution, tier rules, rescue refs on failure and the existing refusal codes all keep their harness coverage
bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh both pass
The clean workspace is removed on every exit path, including gate failure and Ctrl+C
taskRails: Keep scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 in exact parity; parity-check.sh gates the shared strings.
Never use git add -A or a bare git commit; the existing pathspec-only, temp-index landing stays.
A gate failure must still route bytes to a rescue ref, never to the branch.

implementationPlan.description: FREEZE AND EXECUTE THE GATE IN A CLEAN WORKSPACE. Remove gate execution from the shared-project pre-attribution path; retain only selection using completion kind, RunGate/equivalent, qualityGateScope/isEpicFinal and MOE_DISABLE_QUALITY_GATE. After existing pathspec-only attribution and safe-branch selection, build the private index using existing concurrency/tier checks, write-tree, and pin treeSha, actual baseRevision and full refs/heads target. Create a temporary plumbing snapshot commit from that tree/base, without changing a branch or the shared index; an unborn base uses the actual empty-tree object id as the explicitly documented base sentinel and a parentless snapshot. A changed/no-change completion that is eligible to run a gate must still acquire a candidate and run it; existing no-owned/missing-owned refusals must not be transformed into success. Call and require record_candidate BEFORE executing any gate. For an enabled gate create an owned detached worktree from the snapshot, with checkout hooks disabled, normal full checkout (no sparse omission), and no copied/linked shared helpers, node_modules, ignored files or live .moe runtime directories. Assert checkout/index/HEAD start at the frozen tree. Run in worktree plus MOE_REL/Git.Rel so nested Moe projects preserve their cwd, quote paths, clear inherited Git index/worktree/gitdir overrides in the child, and bind child project-path environment to that clean cwd while RPCs still address the original project. Invoke bash -c in sh and the existing ComSpec /d /s /c dialect in ps1; capture actual stdout/stderr and exit code without set-e/pipeline swallowing failures or retaining unbounded output in memory. Report each executed gate via record_check_run for that exact candidate/tree, including failure; never manufacture a pass for a skipped/unstarted command. Afterward verify tracked worktree/index/HEAD still represent the frozen candidate; refuse landing on mutation or a failed integrity probe, retaining the actual command's exit code in its CheckRun and diagnosing the separate integrity failure. Generated untracked build outputs may exist only in the disposable workspace and are never staged or copied back.

implementationPlan.description: INTEGRATE CAS, RESCUE, FINALIZATION AND TOTAL CLEANUP. Put freeze -> record_candidate -> fresh workspace -> gate -> record_check_run inside EACH existing CAS iteration, ahead of branch update. Retain commitHooks behavior and its exact tree/parent validation; build the delivered commit only from frozen tree/base, never by restaging gate outputs. On failed CAS discard that iteration's check eligibility/workspace, read the advanced tip and rebuild using existing attribution/concurrent-change rules; issue a new candidate and rerun even if a gate passed before. Keep the three-attempt cap and MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_REF_CONTENTION. Required gate nonzero or tracked-integrity failure keeps MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE, PUSH-BLOCKED diagnostics, baseline retention and stop-loop behavior, with NO branch update or push. Extend rescue helpers to accept a frozen tree/base snapshot so failures and Ctrl+C during a gate cannot rescue later shared bytes instead; preserve rescue subjects/reasons, path counts and the final failed record_commit after the committed/rescue ledger row. Before freeze is available retain existing attributable-byte rescue fallback. Once a finalizing attempt's postflight outcome/record_commit reporting is complete, call finalize_attempt with the pinned identity/generation and runnerId: committed -> landed + actual 40-hex commit; nothing or deliberate no-git/autoCommit=false -> nothing-to-commit; successfully parked unlanded bytes -> rescued; refusal/unrescued failure -> failed. Never turn push failure after a real branch commit into a claim that no commit landed. Do not finalize ordinary running checkpoints, architect/QA sessions or already-closed attempts as though they were new completions; determine phase from the exact pinned record, not task status alone. Retry acknowledgement at most three times with identical payload and no repeated Git effect; on exhaustion report loudly and stop new-task looping without undoing a landed commit. Use one idempotent workspace cleanup helper from per-iteration finally/normal return AND outer cleanup_temp/PowerShell finally. Register paths in the parent shell (avoid create_secure_temp in an unregistered command-substitution subshell), stop/wait only owned gate children before deletion, remove only this detached worktree and its registration, and continue rescue/finalization/deregister cleanup even after an earlier cleanup error. On Windows validate resolved absolute owned temp paths before removal and use LiteralPath, never cross-shell recursive deletion. Never globally prune worktrees or introduce an idle/quiet-output kill rule.

Running/other-role/closed attempts do not initiate completion acknowledgements; missing/stale tokens fail closed. Gate/evidence/integrity failure skips push and stops looping. Windows suspended process + owned kill-on-close job and Bash owned process group stop descendants before integrity/cleanup; secure temp root now parent-registered.
